verdict.rationale: Anthropic maintains a first-party API release notes page (release-notes/api.md) that records both model launches, such as the flagship's 1M context and always-on adaptive thinking, and API surface changes, such as new fields on GET /v1/models. A standing deprecations page with retirement dates complements it. Missing for 10: no independent or hands-on corroboration of how regularly the changelog is updated, and no evidence of a subscribable feed (RSS, email) or dated-entry structure for following changes.

support.subject: As a developer, model and API changes land in a maintained changelog or release notes I can follow

citations.quote: It has a 1M token context window by default, 128k max output tokens, and always-on adaptive thinking
On Claude Opus 5.5, thinking can't be disabled
`GET /v1/models` and `GET /v1/models/{model_id}` now return `max_input_tokens`, `max_tokens`, and a `capabilities` object.
A standing model-deprecations page plus per-model retirement floors on the models overview
